candidate_relations.reason: Matches the reference diagnosis; the cardiac qualifier is supported by the large inflammatory pericardial effusion, positive ANA and anti-Smith antibodies, low complement, and steroid response.
Cotton-wool spots and severe hypertension support hypertensive retinopathy, but it is not the requested systemic diagnosis.
The large effusion is compatible with lupus pericardial inflammation, but pericarditis alone omits the underlying systemic lupus erythematosus diagnosis.
